result.title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
result.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
result.summary: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. It supplies MixFormerV2 with the fixed initial template, a window-best pre-trigger template, and a trigger-frame Kalman-guided image crop, together with their associated weights, without retraining the visual backbone. In the accuracy evaluation, CMRP achieves 49.90 Macro Success AUC, 2.95 points above MixFormerV2 Official. On selected cross-medium transition and occlusion-recovery intervals, CMRP increases MixFormerV2 tracking coverage from 47.91\% to 50.43\% relative to Official updating, while mean loss-to-recovery latency over successfully recovered videos decreases from 55.3 to 49.3 frames.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对空-水界面视觉跟踪中飞溅、气泡、折射等导致的观测失效，构建了同步动捕位姿、经介质门控残差修正投影并人工复核的跨介质评测集（22,346 帧），并提出 CMRP 恢复策略：以置信度触发模板选择，为 MixFormerV2 提供初始模板、窗口最优预触发模板与触发帧卡尔曼引导裁剪及权重，不重训练骨干，在跨介质与遮挡恢复区间提升跟踪覆盖并缩短恢复延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 置信度触发的模板重选与卡尔曼引导观测恢复，可能为 LVR 中判断视觉证据是否可靠、以及「何时重新 LOOK／补充哪些视觉线索」提供方法线索；但其是否建模内部状态、能否迁移到 latent 推理尚待核查。
